ctx.x: So what, this is tape number 24, the last final tape of Mr. Chuck Green. So, Chuck, what basically happened to the show? What was really the cause of its decline, and why it eventually really didn't make it? When it moved to the Mercury Theater what happened?

Well, it really -- it became another sensation. It starts -- it broke its own record. You see, because people like Celeste Holms, Mrs. Hoot Gibson, Bert Wheeler, Bert Law's sister, you know, and Henny Youngman, Soupy Sales, see, Dorothy Townson and people like that was happening to be in these audiences.
